title: We Tested Strangles Across Sectors, Here’s What Wins More
description:
Implied volatility is consistently overstated across sector ETFs — and the data shows it. Explore strangle success rates across energy, technology, financials, healthcare, and utilities ETFs, why 16 and 30 delta strangles historically outperform theoretical expectations, and how sector ETFs compare to individual stock holdings for premium selling strategies. tastylive's Market Measure breaks down the research.
